name: Ibzan
title: Judge from Bethlehem
summary: Ibzan was one of Israel's so-called 'minor judges' who served after Jephthah. He came from Bethlehem and was known for his large family with thirty sons and thirty daughters. He judged Israel for seven years.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Judge in Israel
keyEvents.description: After Jephthah's death, Ibzan from Bethlehem became judge over Israel.

keyEvents.title: His Large Family
keyEvents.description: Ibzan had thirty sons and thirty daughters, which testified to his wealth and influence in society.

keyEvents.title: Married Off His Children
keyEvents.description: He married off his thirty daughters to men outside his own clan and brought thirty women from outside for his sons, which built alliances.

keyEvents.title: Judged Israel for Seven Years
keyEvents.description: Ibzan served as judge over Israel for seven years and maintained peace in the land during this period.

keyEvents.title: His death and burial
keyEvents.description: Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem, the city from which he came.
